tasks.label: Setup: install backend + frontend deps
tasks.command: python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && cd frontend && npm install
tasks.detail: One-time: creates .venv, installs Python + Node deps (Windows: use .venv\Scripts\activate)

tasks.label: Backend: apply migrations
tasks.detail: Runs Alembic migrations against DATABASE_URL (postgres or sqlite)

tasks.label: Backend: train the model
tasks.detail: Requires data/raw/creditcard.csv (or run with --fake for synthetic demo)

tasks.label: Docker: full stack up
tasks.detail: postgres + redis + api + worker + frontend (needs Docker Desktop)

tasks.label: Tests: backend + frontend
tasks.command: cd backend && . ../.venv/bin/activate && pytest -q && cd ../frontend && npm run test
